minutes.headline: Finance Committee picked members for the town manager search and a proposed budget task force; no budget votes taken.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed the departing town manager and nominated one member to the permanent town manager search committee and another to a proposed budget task force. The town manager reported by Zoom with poor audio. Other items were a state representative's invitation to a school budget meeting with DESE, grant writing services, missing past minutes, and committee reports. Minutes of May 23 were approved.

votes.motion: Nominate Chris Menard to the town manager search committee
Nominate Evan as the finance committee member of the budget task force

budget_items.topic: State storm relief after FEMA denial
budget_items.what_was_said: The state will distribute funds set aside in the supplemental budget to affected towns; Lunenburg's share was stated.
The town manager repeated the governor's office will release the set-aside funds, with Lunenburg's portion based on storm costs, size and infrastructure.
An earmark for a police training simulation system, not funded in the capital plan, is in the state budget but not certain.
Preliminary first and second quarter bills will include a portion of the override amount; the tax rate is set in the fall.
The committee withdrew its spring application because the available grant yield for the sewer project was small.
Green Communities contributed toward police cruisers.

decisions.decision: Members agreed one or more members would attend the state representative's meeting; two members said they could attend the 19th.
The chair will reach out to the school committee and select board chairs about a joint prepared statement, to be circulated before the next meeting.
Miss tarz will work with the town manager on a grant writing services procedure.
The chair will ask the clerk's office about the list of missing minutes and follow up.

topics.topic: Call to order, announcements, town manager departure
Town manager and finance director reports, audio problems
Meeting with state representative and DESE on school budget
Town manager report continued, grant writing services

not_audible: Town manager's first report was largely inaudible

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee moved a nomination to the town manager search committee; the result was not audible in the recording.
A nomination of a Finance Committee member to a proposed budget task force was made; the result was not audible.
Members agreed one or more would attend a state representative's meeting with DESE on the school budget; two said they could attend the 19th.
The chair will ask the school committee and select board chairs about a joint prepared statement, to be circulated before the next meeting.
The town manager said the state will release set-aside storm relief funds after the FEMA denial, and that FY25 preliminary tax bills will include part of the override amount.

why_it_matters: The search committee and budget task force will shape who runs town finances and how the next budget is built, but the recording does not confirm who was chosen.
Preliminary FY25 tax bills including part of the override affects what residents pay in the first two quarters, with the tax rate set in the fall.
watch_next: A joint prepared statement from the Finance Committee, school committee and select board chairs, to be circulated before the next Finance Committee meeting.
The state representative's school budget meeting with DESE on the 19th.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the two nominations and the $30,000 storm aid, but our recording-based minutes and the official minutes differ on many figures, follow-ups, and roles. The main thing to know is that the $5 million, $33,900, $5,000 and 45-to-$50,000 figures and several decisions appear only in ours, and the roster roles conflict.
